chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 24: Scavenging - Li Huowang's Desperate Meal & Final Act
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang must consume the Black Tai Sui to survive, then loots the dead and makes a final, devastating choice regarding the Heavenly Scripture. The aftermath of Danyangzi's fall is grim.
og_title: A Feast of Monsters and a Shattered Scripture
og_description: Chapter 24 of Dao Gui Yi Xian: See the horror of survival as Li Huowang eats a monster and makes a cold, calculating choice about the scripture that cost so many lives.
